analysis: San Francisco is officially without Nick Bosa (calf) this week, their best pass rusher, which pulls a model that was only mildly pro-49ers (Elo margin +3.1) down to a virtual pick em (+1.3 adjusted). The market still has the 49ers favored by 2.5, so this is now a real gap worth tracking, not a repeat of last weeks note.

Public handle (60%) is on the 49ers, and the line has actually moved away from them (-3 to -2.5) since -- a mild reverse line move that lines up with the Bosa news rather than against it. The total also leans under now (42.1 model vs 47.0 market).
